title: ProjectConfigFile
description: Sparse team file .marshall/config/project.json: only deviations from the derived and compiled defaults.

base_branch.description: Integration branch of plans. Default derived from origin/HEAD (derived fact base_branch_default), fallback main. Server rule: the branch exists on the remote (base_branch_unknown).

branch_prefix.description: The server names every plan branch <branch_prefix><plan_id>.

merge_method.description: Override of the derived merge method (one method allowed by the repository -> that one; several -> squash). Server rule: allowed by the repository settings (merge_method_not_allowed).

ci_provider.description: Override of the CI provider derived from the remote host (derived fact ci_provider), for self-hosted remotes. Server rule: the matching host tool is enrolled.

sonar.description: Sonar coordinates of the project. The credential is the operator's (local-config.json integrations.sonar, else the machine's providers.sonar); its token is sent only to that entry's url origin (PM-CRED-5), never to a value of this file.

write_back.description: When true, a plan started from an issue of the project's own repository posts the clarified request after Phase 2 and the approved outline after Phase 3 to it (ci.issue-comment); never to an issue of another repository.

required_bots.description: No default: the presence of the key is the roster answer (absent: never answered, roster aggregate unestablished; []: answered empty, vacuous), so the key is exempt from redundant_config_key. Server rule: every token resolves in the review-bot registry (unregistered_kind); disjoint from optional_bots.

bot_registry.description: Project review-bot registry records (Review-Bot Registry Record); a bot_kind that collides with a compiled record is refused.

currency.description: Strictness of the review currency test of the pre-merge barrier (phase-workflows.adoc, Predicate 2).

operator_paths.description: Default []. Git pathspec globs of the paths whose changes the operator merges: a realized footprint that touches one leaves the merge to the operator whatever the asking axis (phase-workflows.adoc, Operator Paths). Server rule: every glob parses (invalid_glob).
